summary: Plum Acquisition Corp. IV, a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its business combination agreement with Controlled Thermal Resources Holdings Inc. The amendment extends deadlines for the target to deliver financial statements and pro forma financial information to June 15, 2026 and June 30, 2026, respectively, pushes antitrust filing and HSR date to July 31, 2026, and extends certain material consent deliveries. No financial terms, premium, or advisor is disclosed. The SPAC will redomesticate from Cayman Islands to Delaware prior to closing. The merger sub will merge with and into the target. Watch for potential shareholder vote timeline and regulatory clearance risk-arb.
